title: Pump-02 Throttling Valve Restriction Remediation
steps: Silence and acknowledge high pressure alarm ALM-P02-HP on supervisory HMI panel.
Inspect throttling control valve VLV-04-POS position feedback against automated DCS output.
If VLV-04-POS is pinched or restricted below 70%, switch loop to manual bypass mode.
Monitor discharge flow transmitter FIT-02-FLW to verify volumetric recovery above 75 L/min.
Verify motor current MOT-02-CUR subsides below 8.2 A nominal threshold.
Once discharge line pressure PIT-02-PRS stabilizes below 5.2 bar, reset ALM-P02-HP and restore cascade control.
